phrases.latin: In vestibulō avus calceōs exuentibus «Ecce,» inquit, «soccī vestrī,» et utrīque pār suum dedit.
phrases.english: In the hall, as they took off their shoes, Grandpa said, “Here are your slippers,” and gave each of them a pair.
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 113, 118, checked against the searchable text of the book (29 October 2026).
